stops.note: a fine powder of antimony used as eye makeup
scholars in Spain generalized it to mean any fine distilled essence; the physician Paracelsus (1493–1541) called the distilled spirit of wine 'alcohol vini', and chemists later dropped the 'vini'
stops.meaning: a distilled essence or fine powder

stops.note: narrowed to mean the spirit distilled from wine
settled on its modern chemical sense
